mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 74 degrees, though it feels like 81, and we have a waxing gibbous moon shining down on us.

Regarding city news, the sticker design contest for the November election is moving into the voting phase. Students in grades K-12 have submitted their designs, and the public can view and vote for the winning stickers from July 28 through August 7.

We have plenty of local fun ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by multiple trivia options on July 28 and the Downtown Farmer's Market on July 29.
In our police report for the week, on July 15, officers responded to a residence on Prairie Oaks Drive where a 30-year-old man was arrested for felony bail jumping.
Today's flavor is the classic OREO Cookie Overload. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
